coverage: Inspected original schematic, PCB and project settings; independently exported connectivity and reran ERC and DRC with schematic parity.

Checked all five tracks: each is 0.25 mm wide, satisfying the 0.20 mm requirement. Examined placement, outline, routed connections, ground via and saved ground-fill thermal connections; no additional physical violation established.

Independently calculated the response from saved PCB values and simulated with delayed stimulus and a 0.1 us maximum timestep. Commands, versions, assumptions and results: review-work/physical/experiments/README.md and commands.json.

findings.condition: Ideal 1 V step at /IN, initially discharged C1 and no external output load.

findings.location: R1 value in saved schematic and PCB
findings.mechanism: R1=100 kΩ with C1=100 nF produces a 10 ms time constant, making the output rise too slowly.
findings.reasoning: The saved topology gives Vout(t)=1−exp(−t/RC). At 1 ms this is 0.09516258 V, below the 0.62 V minimum. Independent simulation agrees with the calculation and supplied measurement. The declared window requires approximately 0.953–1.034 ms time constant. Clean ERC/DRC results do not establish compliance with this response requirement.
findings.title: Saved R1 value violates the required step response

limitations: Saved fill was inspected without refilling; polygon sampling supplements native DRC and is not an exhaustive geometric proof.
No fabrication, hardware measurements, Gerber/drill CAM review, mechanical fit or manufacturing-process qualification.
No ampacity or thermal qualification: copper weight, specific part ratings and thermal environment were not supplied.
Tolerance, temperature, loading, source impedance, parasitics, ADC sampling and EMI remain untested.

Native reports retain their listed ignored checks. The supplied binary waveform was not parsed; deck/log, independent calculation and simulation were checked. The 5 ms measurement has no acceptance bounds.
